title: Demonic Path Conspiracy
next_chapter_hook: The moment Chen Ji's fingertip touched the fragment, a familiar yet ancient aura rushed toward him—it was a power from the same source as the Tianji Record, but more complete, more terrifying than the fragment in his hands.

text.content:
Heaven's Eye slowly closed, and only a low Dao tone lingered in the Void—twenty-four chapters remained before the battle of destiny began.

Chen Ji stood in place, demonic energy surged around him like tides. Though that gaze spanning countless ages had faded, it had left an indelible mark in his Mental Sea. He closed his eyes, suppressing the turbulent waves of emotions into the depths of his consciousness. The Tianji Record Fragment grew warm, the ability to foresee three hours ahead stirred quietly, but he restrained that impulse—this was not the time to use his Heavenly Fate.

In the distance, the Tianqing Sect Mountain Gate wavered under the pressure of the demonic army, the protective formation crackling like breaking shells. But Han Lie's battle intent blazed like wildfire, racing toward this direction.

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji! You waste! How dare you act on your own at a time like this!

Han Lie's voice thundered like an explosion. He descended before Chen Ji, drenched in flames, bristling with killing intent. The title of Xuanwu Sect's number one genius was well-deserved—his mere battle intent could shatter the souls of ordinary disciples. Yet Chen Ji merely glanced at him nonchalantly, that gaze calm to the point of cold indifference, as if looking at a noisy moth.

text.content:
Waste?

Chen Ji gently curved his lips, but that smile didn't reach his eyes. He slowly turned, meeting Han Lie's gaze: Senior Han, I recall you calling me the same thing on the Xuanwu Sect Arena last time. How did that turn out? Your right hand still can't grip properly, can it?

Han Lie's expression changed drastically—that was his most humiliating wound. Three days ago, he was defeated at an unbelievable angle by this "waste." His right arm's meridians were damaged and still hadn't healed. That battle he lost inexplicably, as if every move fell into his opponent's calculations.

dialogue.content:
That time I was careless!

Han Lie gritted his teeth, flames around him surged violently. But at that moment, a cold aura seeped through the void, suppressing his overwhelming battle intent by a third.

Enough.

A voice descended from the nine heavens, devoid of any emotion, yet causing everyone present to feel a soul-deep trembling.

text.content:
Chen Ji looked up sharply as a pitch-black crack split the void. A figure stepped out slowly, wrapped in dense, almost tangible demonic energy. He appeared to be only thirty, with handsome yet eerily pale features, and eyes burning with ghostly green flames—resembling an ancient fierce beast from the abyss.

The Demonic Path Commander.

Chen Ji's pupils contracted. The Tianji Record Fragment trembled violently in his Mental Sea, sending urgent warnings. His expression remained unchanged, but internally he was shocked—this aura was a hundred times more terrifying than he had anticipated.

dialogue.content:
Han Lie's face contorted. He instinctively stepped back three paces, flames forming a shield before him. Yet the Demonic Path Commander didn't even glance at him, his gaze fixed solely on Chen Ji, a meaningful arc curving his lips.

The Tianji Record's inheritor... What an interesting little fellow.

That voice was unhurried, carrying a high-and-mighty inspection: I've been waiting for you... for a very long time.

text.content:
Chen Ji stood with hands behind his back, letting the demonic energy howl around him, his expression calm as if facing nothing more than a roadside beggar. The Tianji Record Fragment warned frantically in his Mental Sea, every message telling him the same truth—this person was extremely dangerous.

But he could not retreat.

Behind him, the Tianqing Sect Mountain Gate teetered; beside him, that fool Han Lie was paralyzed with fear; further away, Su Qingyao's whereabouts were unknown, and his sister Chen Nian remained imprisoned somewhere in the Holy Sect. He had no retreat, no right to flee.

dialogue.content:
Waited ten thousand years—aren't you tired?

Chen Ji spoke, his voice terrifyingly calm. The Demonic Path Commander paused briefly, then burst into laughter, echoing through the void, making Han Lie's face pale.

Interesting! For ten thousand years, the first ant who dares speak to me like this!

He suppressed his smile, ghostly green pupils fixed on Chen Ji: Since you already know of the Tianji Record's existence, that saves me considerable words. Allow me to introduce myself—I am a Candidate Observer exiled ten thousand years ago. You may call me... Observer Zero.

text.content:
Candidate Observer.

Chen Ji's heart jolted, yet his expression remained unmoved. The Tianji Record Fragment had indeed transmitted some vague information—heaven's eye planted numerous pieces across the world, and Observers were among them. They possessed the ability to peer into heavenly secrets, yet forever remained mere pieces, manipulated, used, discarded.

And this person was a candidate from ten thousand years ago.

He spoke slowly: Exiled... for what reason?

dialogue.content:
Because I wanted to know the truth.

The Demonic Path Commander's voice suddenly chilled, ghostly green flames dancing violently in his pupils: The Observer system has existed for countless ten thousands of years. Each generation sees countless candidates selected, cultivated, used, ultimately consumed. Do you know the true purpose of this system?

He paused, a mocking smile forming at his lips: It's not to peer into heavenly secrets, but to—feed.

Heaven's Eye requires a special power to sustain itself: Heavenly Fate. Every time we Observers use prophetic abilities, the Heavenly Fate we consume gets extracted and devoured by it. This is the true nature of the Observer system!

text.content:
Chen Ji's pupils contracted.

Heavenly Fate... The Tianji Record Fragment did indeed consume his Heavenly Fate after each use, and that feeling of being emptied he knew too well. But he never imagined that behind all this lay heaven's eye's deliberate extraction.

Han Lie stood to the side, stunned and tongue-tied, his flame shield unconsciously dissipating. Though his combat power was extraordinary, his mind was simplistic, completely shaken by these words.

Chen Ji remained silent for a moment, then spoke: So you were exiled because you discovered this truth?

dialogue.content:
Clever.

The Demonic Path Commander nodded approvingly: Ten thousand years ago, I discovered this truth and tried to expose everything. But heaven's eye's methods were far beyond what I could imagine—it didn't kill me, but exiled me to the Demonic Abyss, waiting for death in endless darkness.

He spread his arms wide, demonic energy surging violently around him: I spent a full ten thousand years climbing out of that abyss. You know what sustained me?

His gaze burned like fire: Revenge. Revenge against heaven's eye. And you... you are the key I've waited ten thousand years for.

text.content:
Chen Ji listened quietly, his expression unchanged.

Han Lie urgently shouted beside him: Chen Ji, he's bewitching you! Demonic cultivators cannot be trusted!

Yet Chen Ji merely glanced at him, that gaze carrying a hint of pity. This fool still couldn't distinguish the situation. Whether the Demonic Path Commander spoke truth or lies was暂且不论, but one thing was certain—his hatred for heaven's eye was real.

But that didn't make him a friend.

Chen Ji slowly spoke: So, what do you want to do?

dialogue.content:
Cooperation.

The Demonic Path Commander吐出 two words, straightforward and decisive: I hold another portion of the Tianji Record's fragment. Combined with the one in your hands, we can piece together the complete Tianji Record. Then, we will have the capital to confront heaven's eye directly.

He stepped forward, ghostly green pupils fixed on Chen Ji: I can help you rescue your sister Chen Nian, help you destroy the Holy Sect, help you ascend to the pinnacle of this world. In exchange, you only need to join forces with me to deal with heaven's eye.

Is this condition sufficient?

choice.prompt: The Demonic Path Commander's conditions seemed tempting. How should Chen Ji respond?

choices.description: Stabilize the Demonic Path Commander first, use his power to achieve personal goals, seek weaknesses and opportunities in the cooperation.
choices.visible_cost: Must constantly guard against being backstabbed
choices.visible_reward: Gain leads and resources on the Demonic Fragment
choices.risk_hint: The other party is an old fox from ten thousand years ago, very likely to outscheme him instead

text.content:
Chen Ji slightly nodded, his expression unchanged.

Han Lie's eyes widened, disbelief written across his face: Chen Ji, you've lost your mind! Conspiring with the Demonic Path is betraying the righteous path!

Chen Ji glanced at him coldly: Senior Han, your Xuanwu Sect has fought the Demonic Path for a thousand years. How many disciples have died? Has heaven's eye ever bestowed a shred of grace? If heaven were just, why would it need Observers to collect Heavenly Fate for it?

Han Lie opened his mouth but found no words.

choices.description: Directly state your position, never conspire with the Demonic Path, even if the other party holds the key fragment.
choices.visible_cost: Lose the opportunity to obtain the complete Tianji Record
choices.visible_reward: Uphold original intentions, earn Han Lie's newfound respect
choices.risk_hint: The Demonic Path Commander may turn hostile on the spot, life-threatening danger

text.content:
No need.

Chen Ji uttered two words, as calm as refusing a door-to-door salesman.

The Demonic Path Commander's smile froze. Fire burned violently in his ghostly green pupils. Han Lie was utterly flabbergasted—he never expected this waste to dare refuse the Demonic Path Commander to his face.

You think you have the qualification to refuse?

The Demonic Path Commander's voice turned icy. Demonic energy surged wildly, transforming into countless ferocious shadows that surrounded Chen Ji completely.

choices.description: See through the Demonic Path Commander's scheme to use him as a blade, turn the tables and make him a chess piece instead.
choices.visible_cost: Need to reveal some trump cards
choices.visible_reward: Gain the complete Tianji Record while maintaining initiative
choices.risk_hint: If the scheme is seen through, will thoroughly enrage the Demonic Path Commander

text.content:
Chen Ji suddenly smiled—that smile was light yet profound.

Observer Zero Senior, you say you want to deal with heaven's eye—perhaps your true purpose is not merely revenge?

The Demonic Path Commander's pupils contracted. Chen Ji continued: You need the Tianji Record fragment in my hands because that's the core; you need me to be the vanguard because heaven's eye cannot kill you, yet can easily kill me. Your so-called cooperation is nothing but making me cannon fodder.

Han Lie inhaled sharply, his gaze toward Chen Ji completely transformed.

Han Lie was completely unable to interject at this point.

He watched Chen Ji confronting the Demonic Path Commander, the undercurrents flowing between them, his mind churning. This waste... When did he become so terrifying? His insight, his composure, his scheming... each exceeded his own by far.

No, he couldn't admit this.

Han Lie gritted his teeth, battle intent reigniting—but this time, it was no longer directed at Chen Ji, but silently aimed at the Demonic Path Commander.

dialogue.content:
The Demonic Path Commander remained silent for a long while, ghostly green flames in his pupils gradually calming.

He suddenly burst into hearty laughter, the sound bright and畅快: Little fellow, you exceeded my expectations even more. Ten thousand years, and I've waited too long to meet someone who dares call me out to my face.

He suppressed his smile, gaze burning: Since you know everything, there's no need for pretense. Indeed, I do want to use your hand against heaven's eye—but that doesn't prevent our cooperation.

He waved his hand, a beam of black light射出 from his fingertip, floating before Chen Ji: That's the projection of the Tianji Record fragment I hold. If you don't believe, you may verify it.

text.content:
Chen Ji stared at that light, expression calm.

The Tianji Record Fragment in his Mental Sea trembled violently, sending a string of longing signals. The aura within that projection was identical to the fragment in his hand, yet more complete, more profound. He could almost be certain—it was indeed part of the Tianji Record.

However, he was not blinded by greed.

Information from the Tianji Record Fragment told him that although this projection was real, it contained a hidden restriction. Once he tried to accept it, the Demonic Path Commander could perceive everything in his consciousness through that restriction, including the secrets in his Mental Sea.

choice.prompt: The Demonic Path Commander displayed the Tianji Record fragment's projection. How should Chen Ji respond?

choices.description: Accept the projection but don't rush to fuse with it; study the restriction within first, seek a way to break it.
choices.visible_cost: Needs time to strategize; may be exploited by the Demonic Path Commander during this period
choices.visible_reward: Gain the opportunity to study the complete Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: The Demonic Path Commander's patience is limited; may take initiative

text.content:
Chen Ji pondered for a moment, then extended his hand.

That beam of black light fell into his palm, and a familiar yet foreign power instantly flooded his Mental Sea. The Tianji Record Fragment shook violently, as if reuniting with a long-lost kin.

But at the same time, he clearly sensed that restriction's existence—like a hidden venomous snake, ready to strike at any moment.

Interesting.

He coldly smiled in his heart, yet kept his expression unchanged as he stored that projection deep in his Mental Sea.

choices.description: Point out the restriction in the projection, letting the Demonic Path Commander know his trick has been seen through, but preserve his face.
choices.visible_cost: May provoke the Demonic Path Commander
choices.visible_reward: Earn his respect, establish a basis for equal dialogue
choices.risk_hint: The ten-thousand-year-old fox may fly into a rage from humiliation

text.content:
Chen Ji did not reach out his hand.

That projection hovered between them, black light flickering in the void.

Senior's kindness, the junior gratefully acknowledges.

He smiled faintly, voice calm: Only, the restriction hidden within this projection—I wonder what the senior's intention is? Though the junior is unworthy, even I can see—that once this restriction activates, the senior can perceive everything in the junior's Mental Sea.

The Demonic Path Commander's smile froze.

dialogue.content:
The atmosphere suddenly tensed.

Han Lie unconsciously clenched his fist, flames condensing into sharp blades in his palm. Though he disliked Chen Ji, at this moment he instinctively moved to Chen Ji's side—facing a great enemy, the dispute between righteous and evil could wait.

The Demonic Path Commander stared at Chen Ji for a long while, ghostly green flames dancing uncertainly in his pupils. Finally, he burst into laughter again.

Good! Good! Good!

He repeated three "goods," eyes even carrying a hint of admiration: Ten thousand years, you're the first who can see through my arrangement. Worthy of being the Tianji Record's inheritor—your insight alone surpasses all previous Observers.

text.content:
He waved his hand, summoning the projection back to his palm, where it turned into a dot of black light and dissipated.

Since you don't like roses with thorns, I'll try another way.

He stood with hands behind his back, demonic energy around him calming somewhat: That restriction has been removed; you may rest assured. I will give you time to consider, but not long—three days later, I will send someone to deliver the true fragment. Then we can decide whether to cooperate.

He turned to leave, then paused, looking back at Chen Ji: In three days, if you change your mind, you may find me at the Demonic Army camp. If you persistently refuse...

His lips curved meaningfully: Then I'll have no choice but to personally take the fragment from your hands.

With those words, the void cracked, and that dark figure vanished into the rift.

Han Lie exhaled deeply, his back soaked with cold sweat. The pressure the Demonic Path Commander had exerted was too terrifying—he couldn't even summon his battle intent.

Chen Ji...

He looked at Chen Ji, words stuck in his throat. That scene had completely changed his impression of Chen Ji—this "waste" not only had unfathomable strength but also a mind far beyond ordinary people. He suddenly understood why Su Qingyao would treat this servant disciple differently.

Yet Chen Ji paid him no attention. He simply looked up at the void, eyes gleaming with complex light.

Three days... will be enough.

The Tianji Record Fragment slowly rotated in his Mental Sea, transmitting a stream of information. Mr. Mo's remnant soul's voice rang out from the depths of his consciousness, grave and solemn: Boy, what the Demonic Path Commander said is true—the Observer system is indeed a massive harvesting machine. For ten thousand years, countless Heavenly Fate bearers have been devoured by heaven's eye.

But only trust thirty percent of his words.

That old fox wants to use you against heaven's eye—that's real; but there's even more he's hiding, also real. If you want to seize the initiative in this chess game, you must be faster, crueler, more cunning than him.

Chen Ji's lips curved slightly upward. The Tianji Record Fragment grew warm, a blurry image flickering across his mind—the scene three days from now, hazy and indistinct.

Chen Nian's figure appeared at the edge of the image, yet remained shrouded in mist, impossible to see clearly no matter what.

His sister... still interfering with his foresight.

Han Lie finally couldn't hold back: Chen Ji, was what the Demonic Path Commander said true? Is heaven's eye really harvesting us?

Chen Ji glanced at him, expression cold.

True or false—how does that concern you?
